paper_record.title: Two-exciton bound states in the Merrifield exciton model
paper_record.abstract: Understanding the formation and dynamics of two-exciton bound states (BSs) is crucial for harnessing multi-exciton phenomena and designing next-generation organic semiconductor materials. While various mechanisms such as intermolecular exciton-exciton interactions or multi-level intramolecular configurations can generate these BSs, a fundamental understanding of their underlying lattice dynamics remains a key challenge. Within this context, the Merrifield exciton model stands out as a premier framework for capturing the intricate quantum mixing between single-site doubly-excited states and two-particle scattering continuum. In this work, by constructing a set of exact two-exciton Bloch states and applying a plane-wave ansatz to treat the resulting inhomogeneous tridiagonal matrices, we provide a complete, rigorous solution to the two-exciton problem in a finite-size Merrifield chain. We analytically map the parameter regions that support two-exciton BSs, proving that at most two distinct types of BSs can emerge, located either above or below the scattering continuum. Furthermore, we provide a quantitative interpretation of how these two types of BSs evolve as a function of the total wave number within the whole Brillouin zone. The obtained closed-form expressions for the eigenenergies and wave functions offer valuable benchmarks for exploring exciton dynamics and optical responses in related molecular aggregates.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文通过平面波拟设方法，给出了有限尺寸 Merrifield 激子模型中双激子问题的完整解析解。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper provides a complete analytical solution to the two-exciton problem in a finite-size Merrifield exciton model using a plane-wave ansatz.

problem.zh: 理解 Merrifield 模型中双激子束缚态的形成机制、参数依赖性及其在布里渊区内的演化规律。
problem.en: Understanding the formation mechanisms, parameter dependence, and evolution of two-exciton bound states within the Brillouin zone in the Merrifield model.

approach.zh: 构建双激子 Bloch 态，将双激子问题映射为单粒子问题，并利用平面波拟设求解非均匀三对角矩阵。
approach.en: Constructing two-exciton Bloch states, mapping the two-exciton problem to a single-particle one, and solving the resulting inhomogeneous tridiagonal matrices using a plane-wave ansatz.

main_takeaway.zh: Merrifield 模型中最多存在两种双激子束缚态，其存在条件及演化由系统参数和总波数决定，且束缚态总是位于散射连续谱之外。
main_takeaway.en: At most two types of two-exciton bound states exist in the Merrifield model, with their emergence and evolution determined by system parameters and total wave number, always lying outside the scattering continuum.

why_it_matters.zh: 该解析解为研究有机分子聚集体中的激子动力学、非线性光学响应及单线态激子裂分过程提供了重要的理论基准。
why_it_matters.en: The analytical solution provides essential theoretical benchmarks for studying exciton dynamics, nonlinear optical responses, and singlet fission processes in organic molecular aggregates.

reason.zh: 文章通过严谨的数学推导澄清了 Merrifield 模型中双激子束缚态的分类及其随波数演化的复杂行为。
reason.en: The paper clarifies the classification of two-exciton bound states and their complex evolution with wave number in the Merrifield model through rigorous mathematical derivation.

reason.zh: 该期刊是凝聚态物理领域发表此类晶格模型解析解研究的典型平台。
reason.en: This journal is a standard venue for research on analytical solutions of lattice models in condensed matter physics.
